name: LinkedIn Headshots
tagline: Polished, recruiter-ready headshots that still look like you.
description: Professional headshots for LinkedIn, résumés, company pages and speaker bios. Clean studio and office backdrops, flattering soft light, business and smart-casual wardrobe, and natural expressions that read as confident and approachable.
negativePrompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, painting, deformed face, distorted features, extra fingers, bad hands, blurry, out of focus, oversaturated, heavy makeup, harsh shadows, text, watermark, logo, cropped head
